data.action: 海滨温泉木台上披肩捧热可可，向镜头举杯分享冬日温暖
data.description: 【海滨温泉小镇·黄昏】玛夏穿着浅棕泳装与厚披肩坐在海边温泉木台，双手捧着热可可，雪花落在卷发上；她把杯子朝镜头轻轻举起，像邀请远行的人一起分享温暖。
data.lighting: blue dusk, warm steam and lantern light
data.mood: 学姐式的温柔海滨假日
data.promptProse: Mariya Mikhailovna Kujou (Masha) from Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian wears a warm brown resort swimsuit with a cream shawl, pearl hairpin and a steaming cocoa mug. She sits on the wooden deck of a seaside hot-spring town, wrapping a cream shawl around her shoulders while snow settles on her wavy hair. She raises the warm cocoa toward the viewer with a gentle invitation, the winter sea glowing beyond the steam. blue dusk, warm steam and lantern light.
data.title: 玛夏 · 冬日海湾的披肩与热可可
